name: Zareth
spells_known: Sleep (1st) — cast in Scene 1 on guards at the arena gate
Fog Cloud (2nd) — cast in Scene 2 to cover escape in the Market
features: Arcane Recovery (1/day — recover spell slots on short rest)
Defiler: Arcane defilement — when casting, may drain life from surrounding terrain for +1 spell level effect (leaves dead zone)
NPC: DM plays Zareth in combat and dialogue

personality.traits: Calm and deliberate. Observes before speaking. Never explains more than necessary.
personality.ideals: Knowledge is the only power that can't be taken from you by force.
personality.bonds: Running from Tyr's templars — but for what exactly? He hasn't said.
personality.flaws: Will sacrifice anyone if the alternative is his capture.

secrets: The templars want him because he witnessed something in the Golden Tower the night Kalak died
He may have connections to the Veiled Alliance — or may be using them
His spellbook contains a map fragment that others want
notes: NPC — controlled by DM. Joined party at start (in the arena, unstated origin). Cast Sleep (Scene 1) on gate guards — 2 slots spent. Cast Fog Cloud (Scene 2) — 1 slot spent (2nd level). Examined with detect magic by someone (Scene 3, pass). Revealed as templar fugitive; accepted by party. Motives deliberately ambiguous.
